summary.en: The cube unfolds into a flat cross, its six squares slide into the six panels of the generated docs page, the panels fill and the highlight jumps to the endpoint the film follows.
summary.zh: 立方体展开成十字，六个方块滑进生成的文档页的六块面板，面板填上内容，高亮跳到片子跟踪的那个接口。

fits: A source that becomes an interface: spec to docs, model to dashboard, config to console.
notFor: Interfaces that are not six panels; real screenshots.

intent.en: The source unfolds into the interface it generates, so 'one spec in, every doc out' is shown as geometry.
intent.zh: 源头展开成它生成的界面，“一份规格进，全部文档出”用几何讲出来。

content.en: Two captions (≤ 15 chars / 7 字 each), the reference title (≤ 24 / 12 字), a code sample [language, line], the product facts (endpoints, body, call, SDKs).
content.zh: 两行说明（各 ≤ 15 字符 / 7 字），说明页标题（≤ 24 / 12 字），代码示例 [语言, 一行]，产品事实（接口、响应体、调用、SDK）。

fits.zh: 源头变成界面：规格到文档、模型到仪表盘、配置到控制台。

notFor.zh: 不是六块面板的界面；真实截图。

pairs.note: gathers the page into one card

en: Endpoint paths are shown as their last segment; long paths still overflow the 340 px list.
zh: 接口路径只显示最后一段；太长仍会超出 340 px 的列表。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
